findings.issue_text: Fallback locales are preloaded only during controller requests, so background jobs, mailers, and scheduled tasks can perform fallback lookup before the site-default and English locale files are loaded, causing missing translations

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: Fallback locales are preloaded only during controller requests, so background jobs, mailers, and scheduled tasks can perform fallback lookup before the site-default and English locale files are loaded, causing missing translations

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` method in `application_controller.rb`, which is a controller callback. The `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` method loads the fallback locale chain (user locale, site default, English). Background jobs, mailers, and scheduled tasks don't go through the controller, so they won't trigger this preloading. When `FallbackLocaleList#[]` is called during fallback lookup in these contexts, the fallback locales may not be loaded yet, potentially causing missing translations. This is a valid concern since the previous `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` was set at the environment level and would apply globally.
